issue.title: Article completion tests still use the 150 ms production deadline under suite load
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-ex.1 note #1; corroborating report in bob-cli-ex.2.1 note #2. tests/cli/articles.rs complete() at line 40 calls bob_command(), unlike tests/cli/support.rs bob_completion_command(), which sets BOB_COMPLETE_DEADLINE_MS=10000. The article helper was added by ff97c620 (closed epic bob-cli-8g.4) and is unchanged in e2838ac3. Route this helper through the existing test helper, leave the 150 ms production default unchanged, and verify both article completion nodes in isolation and under suite load. Same-type/all-type searches and last-week sweeps found no article-node report. Closed bob-cli-b9 fixed the aliases helper only; do not reopen it for these distinct nodes. Active bob-cli-3j owns the production engine, but the omission is in the independently added article tests, not its already-fixed helpers. No fresh failure reproduced by this lander; evidence is the named phase fail/pass reports plus independent source audit.

task_type_fields.evidence: bob-cli-ex.1 note #1: adopt_note_completion_is_a_vault_note and article_note_completion_shows_section_count failed once in full just test, then passed alone and on retry on the unchanged tree (total repetitions unspecified). bob-cli-ex.2.1 note #2 reports the adopt node failed in check ToolRun 5dae6d51 and passed isolated and in a complete CLI rerun. Both share complete() with the unpinned 150 ms production deadline; source audit at e2838ac3 confirms the omission. Not attributed to project-note changes.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-ex.1 reported both article completion tests fail once under the full suite and pass unchanged in isolation and on retry. Landing audit found their shared helper still bypasses the existing generous test-only completion deadline.
